subject: Tree Ordinance Endorsement and Electrify Medford Campaign
overview: The committee elected three new co-chairs and voted to endorse draft tree ordinances for public and private property to the City Council. Members also planned outreach strategies for the grant-funded Electrify Medford campaign and received a report on the COP28 climate summit.

items.title: Minutes and Administrative Updates
items.summary: Approved the December 4 meeting minutes and discussed managing increased public interest in joining the committee despite a lack of current openings.

items.title: Election of Co-Chairs
items.summary: Approved a three-way co-chair leadership arrangement involving Sarah Singh, Will Sherwin, and Dan.

items.title: Tree Ordinance Drafts
items.summary: Trees Medford presented revised drafts for public, private, and tree committee ordinances, emphasizing data transparency and mitigation fees for private tree removals.

items.title: Tree Ordinance Endorsement
items.summary: Approved a motion to endorse the final product of the tree ordinance drafts for submission to the City Council.

items.title: EV Charging and Community Events
items.summary: Staff announced four new electric vehicle charging stations and a public survey for future sites, while noting an upcoming Mothers Out Front event on January 31.

items.title: Electrify Medford Outreach Plan
items.summary: The committee reviewed outreach methods for the MassCEC Empower grant, suggesting utility bill inserts, neighborhood canvassing, and resident case studies to address heat pump 'cold anxiety.'

items.title: 2024 Meeting Calendar
items.summary: Established the 2024 meeting schedule and tentatively set the Harvest Your Energy Festival for October 19.

items.title: COP28 Climate Summit Report
items.summary: Paul presented a summary of the COP28 summit in Dubai, highlighting the agreement to transition away from fossil fuels and the significant presence of industry lobbyists.
